title: The Self-Duality Equations on a Riemann Surface and Four-Dimensional Chern-Simons Theory
summary: We construct a Lagrangian formulation of Hitchin's self-duality equations on a Riemann surface $Σ$ using potentials for the connection and Higgs field. This two-dimensional action is then obtained from a four-dimensional Chern-Simons theory on $Σ\times \mathbb{CP}^1$ with an appropriate choice of meromorphic 1-form on $\mathbb{CP}^1$ and boundary conditions at its poles.
